text: There should be an option: if you're a coach, please make sure that you follow your standard operating procedures for onboarding your clients. If you're a client, then we take them through the park queue. If you're a coach, it should be able to be toggled: do you want to follow your park queue because you are not a fitness professional, or are you a fitness professional just pulling a program for one of your clients? Please make sure that you follow up on our Q&A health status, that kind of thing. All the health checks should be there as an option. I want to be able to bypass it if I'm a coach and I just want to get it done. Meaning that it should have some type of legal warning to the coach. If they're building programs for people, they should be able to have their own park use because we release all liability for this. We want everyone that's using it, every time they're going to get it, to release liability, whether it be a client or a coach.
